destination_translations.headline: River, Carnival and Caribbean life
destination_translations.intro: Discover Barranquilla between the Magdalena River, Carnival neighbourhoods and Mallorquín mangroves. Explore its waterfront, cultural spaces and Caribbean streets in a city connected to both river and sea.
destination_translations.meta_description: Explore Barranquilla: the Gran Malecón waterfront, Carnival culture, Mallorquín mangroves, Puerto Mocho Beach and places to visit in Atlántico.

destination_translations.headline: Río, Carnaval y Caribe
destination_translations.intro: Barranquilla se descubre entre el Magdalena, los barrios del Carnaval y los manglares de Mallorquín. Recorre su paseo fluvial, visita espacios culturales y conoce una ciudad caribeña que mira al río y al mar.
destination_translations.meta_description: Descubre Barranquilla: Gran Malecón, cultura del Carnaval, manglares de Mallorquín, Puerto Mocho y lugares para conocer en la capital del Atlántico.

destination_translations.headline: Rio, Carnaval e Caribe
destination_translations.intro: Conheça Barranquilla entre o rio Magdalena, os bairros do Carnaval e os manguezais de Mallorquín. Explore a orla fluvial, os espaços culturais e as ruas caribenhas de uma cidade ligada ao rio e ao mar.
destination_translations.meta_description: Conheça Barranquilla: Gran Malecón, cultura do Carnaval, manguezais de Mallorquín, praia de Puerto Mocho e atrações na capital do Atlántico.

destination_story_translations.body: The Magdalena River is central to Barranquilla’s history. Trade and port activity drove its growth, connecting the city to inland Colombia and international routes.

El río Magdalena explica buena parte de la historia de Barranquilla. El comercio y la actividad portuaria impulsaron su crecimiento y la conectaron con el interior colombiano y con rutas internacionales.
O rio Magdalena ajuda a explicar a história de Barranquilla. O comércio e a atividade portuária impulsionaram seu crescimento e conectaram a cidade ao interior colombiano e a rotas internacionais.

Migration, local trades and Caribbean traditions shaped its neighbourhoods and cultural life. Carnival brings together music, dance and knowledge that remain alive beyond the festival, particularly in Barrio Abajo and the Carnival Museum.

Migraciones, oficios y tradiciones caribeñas dieron forma a sus barrios y a su vida cultural. El Carnaval reúne músicas, danzas y saberes que siguen vivos fuera de los días de fiesta, especialmente en espacios como Barrio Abajo y el Museo del Carnaval.

Migrações, ofícios e tradições caribenhas moldaram seus bairros e sua vida cultural. O Carnaval reúne músicas, danças e saberes que permanecem vivos fora da festa, especialmente em Barrio Abajo e no Museu do Carnaval.

The Gran Malecón and Mallorquín offer different connections with water: an urban promenade beside the Magdalena and trails through a mangrove ecosystem. These distinct settings should not be confused with open beaches.

El Gran Malecón y la recuperación de espacios de Mallorquín ofrecen maneras distintas de acercarse al agua: un paseo urbano frente al Magdalena y recorridos por un ecosistema de manglar. Son paisajes diferentes que conviene conocer sin confundirlos con playas abiertas.

O Gran Malecón e Mallorquín oferecem relações diferentes com a água: um passeio urbano às margens do Magdalena e trilhas num ecossistema de manguezal. São paisagens distintas, que não devem ser confundidas com praias abertas.

destination_reason_translations.body: Walk beside the Magdalena and enjoy the river landscape.
Caminar por el borde del Magdalena y observar el paisaje fluvial.
Caminhar às margens do Magdalena e apreciar a paisagem fluvial.
Explore Carnival culture beyond the festival dates.
Acercarte a la cultura del Carnaval durante todo el año.
Conhecer a cultura do Carnaval além das datas da festa.
Combine city streets, mangroves and beach within the district.
Combinar ciudad, manglar y playa sin salir del distrito.
Combinar cidade, manguezal e praia no mesmo distrito.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Gran Malecón del Río
point_of_interest_translations.description: A promenade beside the Magdalena with paths, green spaces and places to gather. The waterfront has several sections: choose a stretch to explore at your own pace, remembering this is a riverfront rather than a seafront.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Gran Malecón del Río
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un paseo para acercarte al Magdalena entre senderos, zonas verdes y espacios de encuentro. El corredor reúne varios sectores: elige un tramo y recórrelo a tu ritmo, sin confundir el río con el mar.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Gran Malecón del Río
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um passeio às margens do Magdalena com caminhos, áreas verdes e espaços de convivência. O corredor tem vários setores: escolha um trecho para conhecer no seu ritmo, lembrando que esta é uma orla fluvial.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Mallorquín Wetland Ecopark
point_of_interest_translations.description: Raised boardwalks bring visitors close to mangroves and the wetland landscape. This is a nature visit within the district; check admission conditions and respect designated trails and wildlife.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Ecoparque Ciénaga de Mallorquín
point_of_interest_translations.description: Las pasarelas permiten acercarse al manglar y al paisaje de la ciénaga. Es una visita de naturaleza dentro del distrito; consulta las condiciones de ingreso y respeta los senderos habilitados y la fauna.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Ecoparque Ciénaga de Mallorquín
point_of_interest_translations.description: As passarelas aproximam os visitantes dos manguezais e da paisagem da lagoa. É um passeio de natureza dentro do distrito; consulte as condições de entrada e respeite as trilhas abertas e a fauna.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Carnival Museum
point_of_interest_translations.description: In Barrio Abajo, this museum explores the festival’s music, dance, costumes and history. Its colourful facade distinguishes it from the neighbouring Casa del Carnaval. Check visiting arrangements before going.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Museo del Carnaval
point_of_interest_translations.description: En Barrio Abajo, este museo propone un acercamiento a las músicas, danzas, vestuarios e historia de la fiesta. Su fachada multicolor lo distingue de la vecina Casa del Carnaval. Consulta la programación de visitas antes de ir.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Museu do Carnaval
point_of_interest_translations.description: Em Barrio Abajo, o museu apresenta músicas, danças, trajes e a história da festa. Sua fachada multicolorida o diferencia da vizinha Casa del Carnaval. Consulte as condições de visita antes de ir.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Barrio Abajo: an open-air museum
point_of_interest_translations.description: A neighbourhood shaped by popular memory and Carnival, where murals invite a slower look at the streets. This is a living residential area: respect its residents and remember that artworks may change.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Barrio Abajo: museo a cielo abierto
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un barrio ligado a la memoria popular y al Carnaval, donde los murales invitan a mirar las calles con calma. La ruta atraviesa un barrio vivo: respeta a sus habitantes y ten presente que las intervenciones artísticas pueden cambiar.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Barrio Abajo: museu a céu aberto
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um bairro ligado à memória popular e ao Carnaval, onde os murais convidam a observar as ruas com calma. É um bairro vivo: respeite os moradores e lembre que as intervenções artísticas podem mudar.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Ventana al Mundo
point_of_interest_translations.description: Coloured panels and a large opening make this monument one of Barranquilla’s recognisable silhouettes. It stands at the Circunvalar roundabout near Vía 40, separate from the Gran Malecón; plan the journey between them.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Ventana al Mundo
point_of_interest_translations.description: Los paneles de colores y la abertura de este monumento lo convierten en una silueta reconocible de Barranquilla. Está en la rotonda de la Circunvalar, cerca de Vía 40, separado del Gran Malecón; planifica el traslado entre ambos.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Ventana al Mundo
point_of_interest_translations.description: Os painéis coloridos e a grande abertura tornam o monumento uma silhueta reconhecível de Barranquilla. Fica na rotatória da Circunvalar, perto da Vía 40, separado do Gran Malecón; planeje o deslocamento entre os dois.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Puerto Mocho Beach
point_of_interest_translations.description: The district’s beach reveals another side of Barranquilla, with sand and a coastal setting distinct from the Magdalena promenade. Check access, services and official advice; this guide does not certify swimming conditions.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Playa de Puerto Mocho
point_of_interest_translations.description: La playa del distrito muestra otra cara de Barranquilla, con arena y un entorno costero diferente del paseo del Magdalena. Comprueba accesos, servicios y recomendaciones de las autoridades; esta guía no certifica condiciones de baño.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Praia de Puerto Mocho
point_of_interest_translations.description: A praia do distrito revela outra face de Barranquilla, com areia e um ambiente costeiro diferente do passeio do Magdalena. Confira os acessos, serviços e orientações oficiais; este guia não certifica condições para banho.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Plaza de la Paz and María Reina Cathedral
point_of_interest_translations.description: The square and cathedral form a civic and religious ensemble of modern architecture. The church is distinguished by its angular facade. Enjoy the exterior and confirm access if you wish to visit inside.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Plaza de la Paz y Catedral María Reina
point_of_interest_translations.description: La plaza y la catedral forman un conjunto cívico y religioso de arquitectura moderna. Las formas angulares de la fachada distinguen el templo. Disfruta la vista exterior y confirma el acceso si quieres conocer el interior.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Plaza de la Paz e Catedral María Reina
point_of_interest_translations.description: A praça e a catedral formam um conjunto cívico e religioso de arquitetura moderna. As formas angulares da fachada distinguem o templo. Aprecie o exterior e confirme o acesso se quiser conhecer o interior.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Panoramic bus tour
point_of_interest_translations.description: Explore city landmarks on a guided sightseeing bus. Check the itinerary and departures before visiting.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Bus panorámico por Barranquilla
point_of_interest_translations.description: Recorre distintos puntos de la ciudad a bordo de un bus turístico con acompañamiento. Confirma el itinerario y las salidas antes de la visita.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Passeio de ônibus panorâmico
point_of_interest_translations.description: Conheça pontos da cidade em um ônibus turístico com acompanhamento. Confirme o itinerário e as saídas antes da visita.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Boat trip on the Magdalena River
point_of_interest_translations.description: See the river landscape and city from a boat departing from the Puerta de Oro sector. Check available routes and departures.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Navegación por el río Magdalena
point_of_interest_translations.description: Conoce el paisaje fluvial y la ciudad desde una embarcación que sale del sector Puerta de Oro. Consulta los recorridos y zarpes disponibles.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Passeio pelo rio Magdalena
point_of_interest_translations.description: Conheça a paisagem fluvial e a cidade em uma embarcação que parte do setor Puerta de Oro. Consulte os trajetos e as saídas disponíveis.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Tourist train to Puerto Mocho
point_of_interest_translations.description: Travel from Las Flores to Puerto Mocho beach on the tourist train. Check service and tickets for your visit.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Tren turístico hacia Puerto Mocho
point_of_interest_translations.description: Viaja desde Las Flores hacia la playa de Puerto Mocho en el tren turístico. Confirma la operación y los tiquetes para tu visita.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Trem turístico até Puerto Mocho
point_of_interest_translations.description: Viaje de Las Flores até a praia de Puerto Mocho no trem turístico. Confirme o funcionamento e os ingressos para a visita.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Panoramic views from Luna del Río
point_of_interest_translations.description: Ride the observation wheel at the Gran Malecón for another perspective on the Magdalena River and Barranquilla.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Vista panorámica desde la Luna del Río
point_of_interest_translations.description: Sube a la rueda panorámica del Gran Malecón para observar el río Magdalena y Barranquilla desde otra perspectiva.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Vista panorâmica da Luna del Río
point_of_interest_translations.description: Suba na roda panorâmica do Gran Malecón para observar o rio Magdalena e Barranquilla de outra perspectiva.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Experience Barranquilla Carnival
point_of_interest_translations.description: Music, dance, costumes and parades fill the streets during Carnival. This is a seasonal celebration: check the programme and conditions for each event.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Vivir el Carnaval de Barranquilla
point_of_interest_translations.description: Música, danzas, disfraces y desfiles toman las calles durante el Carnaval. Es una celebración de temporada: revisa la programación y las condiciones de cada evento.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Vivencie o Carnaval de Barranquilla
point_of_interest_translations.description: Música, danças, fantasias e desfiles tomam as ruas durante o Carnaval. É uma celebração de temporada: consulte a programação e as condições de cada evento.
